Subject: Updated MAP + final signoff window

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the run-through yesterday. Attaching the latest mutual action plan (Tidal_MAP_v3.pdf). We updated the kickoff/start-date assumptions to Nov 1 and added a short procurement checklist for our side.

We need to lock the final signoff timeline this week so our internal PM can freeze resources. Two asks:
- Can Redwood commit to an exec-signature window between Oct 11–15?
- If legal needs more time, do you have an expedited fallback (escalation / credits) to protect our go-live?

If you can confirm the signing flow and a primary/secondary start date by EOD Friday, that will help our SRE scheduling.

Thanks —
Arianna

Arianna — thanks for the MAP and the clear asks. Quick summary from our side after the eval:

- Evaluation status: green across latency/cost/accuracy for the pilot (see attached eval-summary-2027-09.xlsx).
- Proposed start date: we can target Nov 1 for production ramp assuming signoff by Oct 15.
- Primary signer window: we can schedule DocuSign routing Oct 11–15.

Action items for Redwood (my side):
1) Loop in Legal for contract redlines and confirm signer chain (Camila + Kimberly).
2) Produce SLO statement and onboarding runbook for your SRE (delivery by Oct 6).
3) Provide DocuSign routing + HubSpot deal record for your procurement.

Camila / Kimberly — tagging you both for legal/contract timeline and whether Oct 11–15 is realistic. If legal needs more time, we should decide on a fallback (escalation to exec for quick approval, and a holdback credit until final redline closure).

Thanks —

Team — quick legal note after a draft review:

- We received Tidal's latest redline set (thanks Arianna). We can turn around a countersigned DocuSign flow in ~5 business days once procurement confirms standard PO/terms. That puts us on track for the Oct 11–15 signer availability if procurement responds by Oct 6.
- Required signer chain: Procurement (procurement@tidalretail.com) -> Legal (Tidal GC) -> Tidal CFO (exec). On our side: Kimberly Park (Legal) -> Camila Reyes (CS/Onboarding) -> Rishi (Sales exec).
- If procurement is delayed: recommend we activate the fallback authorization path — exec approval via an internal approval memo + allocation of an interim credit for first 30 days (to protect Tidal). I can prepare the memo template.

I'll attach redline-notes-legal.docx with high-level items. Arianna, please confirm the procurement contact and whether they can accept DocuSign-only flow.

Kimberly
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redline-notes-legal.docx (document)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + final signoff window

All — operational confirmation from onboarding:

- We have capacity for a Nov 1 start with a standard Dedicated ramp (2wk pilot -> scale), provided we get final signoff by Oct 20.
- If DocuSign completes in the Oct 11–15 window, we will queue a technical kickoff for Oct 18.
- If signing slips beyond Oct 20, we can still do a staggered start (limited pilot while legal closes). That requires a short SOW addendum and the interim credit Kim mentioned.

I'll prepare the onboarding checklist and straw timeline and share by Oct 7.

—Priyom
Head of Solutions Operations | Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Arianna Ford <arianna.ford@tidalretail.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Bcc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2027 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: Go decision + two-path signoff and start-date plan (action required)

Arianna — putting the final decision plan in one place so procurement can pick the flow: we are ready to go (GO) with the following conditional signoff options. Please confirm which flow you want by COB Monday (Oct 11).

Flow A — Standard (preferred) - DocuSign routing: Oct 11–15. - Routing order: Tidal Procurement -> Tidal GC -> Tidal CFO -> Redwood countersign. - If DocuSign completes, Redwood will begin technical kickoff Oct 18 and target Nov 1 production ramp.

Flow B — Expedited fallback (if procurement delays) - Procures does not respond by Oct 6 or requests extra time: Tidal exec sign-off via emailed approval (CFO or EVP) + Redwood interim credit for first 30 days. - Kimberly will produce an internal approval memo template and Redwood finance will issue a one-time credit note. - Onboarding can start in a limited pilot mode the week of Oct 25. Full production still targeted for Nov 1 once contract is final.

Required next steps (Arianna / Tidal):
1) Confirm which flow (A or B) by COB Mon Oct 11.
2) Provide procurement contact email or confirm if procurement@tidalretail.com accepts DocuSign-only.
3) If Flow A: expect DocuSign link from us on Oct 11 (we will populate with redlines).

DocuSign link (will be live Oct 11): https://docusign.net/Signing/?t=0a9f2c
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4821

If I don't hear back, we'll default to Flow B and Kimberly will prepare the memo & Priyom will stage the pilot resources.

Thanks —
Rishi
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0148
Attachment: onboarding-checklist-strawtimeline.pdf (will follow)
